ENGLISH LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing: Open ended Compositions, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing: Open ended Compositions.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing: Open ended Compositions.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing: Open ended Compositions.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing: Open ended Compositions.

2. When practising Pronunciation and Vocabulary, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Pronunciation and Vocabulary.

3. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. went
   B. going
   C. goes
   D. goed

6. When practising Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary.

   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading.

   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Extensive Reading.

9. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. run
   B. happiness
   C. quickly
   D. blue

10. When practising Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns.

   D. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns.

11. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a describing word
   B. Only an action
   C. A person, place, thing, or idea
   D. Only a joining word

12. When practising Listening and Speaking Listening Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)

14. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library
   B. Where is the Library
   C. where is the library
   D. Where is the library?

15. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. No full stops
   B. One main idea with supporting sentences
   C. Many unrelated topics with no link
   D. Only one word repeated

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Word Class: Adjectives and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
